figurative_meaning_en: The head or chief clerk of any department in an office
example_sentences_in_bangla: অফিসের বড়বাবু ছাড়া কেউ সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারবে না।
বড়বাবু আজ ছুটি নিয়েছেন, তাই কাজটা স্থগিত হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: No one can make a decision without the big boss in the office.
The head clerk is on leave today, so the work has been postponed.
history: Originated from colonial-era Bengali bureaucracy where 'babu' referred to educated clerks in British offices, evolving to denote senior administrative roles.
note: Reflects the socio-economic structure of urban Bengal during and post-colonial times.
